path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2712. “Cover”; procurement by buyer of substitute goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2712. “Cover”; procurement by buyer of substitute goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2712. “Cover”; procurement by buyer of substitute goods (2023)
content:
(a) Right and manner of cover.--After a breach within section 2711 (relating to remedies of buyer in general;  security
      interest of buyer in rejected goods) the buyer may “cover” by making in good faith
      and without unreasonable delay any reasonable purchase of or contract to purchase
      goods in substitution for those due from the seller.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2713. Damages of buyer for nondelivery or repudiation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2713. Damages of buyer for nondelivery or repudiation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2713. Damages of buyer for nondelivery or repudiation (2023)
content:
(a) Damages recoverable.--Subject to the provisions of this division with respect to proof of market price
      (section 2723), the measure of damages for nondelivery or repudiation by the seller
      is the difference between the market price at the time when the buyer learned of the
      breach and the contract price, together with any incidental and consequential damages
      provided in this division (section 2715), but less expenses saved in consequence of
      the breach by the seller.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2716. Right of buyer to specific performance or replevin
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2716. Right of buyer to specific performance or replevin
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2716. Right of buyer to specific performance or replevin (2023)
content:
(a) Specific performance.--Specific performance may be decreed where the goods are unique or in other proper
      circumstances.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2714. Damages of buyer for breach in regard to accepted goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2714. Damages of buyer for breach in regard to accepted goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2714. Damages of buyer for breach in regard to accepted goods (2023)
content:
(a) Damages for nonconformity of tender.--Where the buyer has accepted goods and given notification (section 2607(c) ) he
      may recover as damages for any nonconformity of tender the loss resulting in the ordinary
      course of events from the breach of the seller as determined in any manner which is
      reasonable.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2708. Damages of seller for nonacceptance or repudiation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2708. Damages of seller for nonacceptance or repudiation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2708. Damages of seller for nonacceptance or repudiation (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to subsection (b) and to the provisions of this division with respect to
      proof of market price (section 2723), the measure of damages for nonacceptance or
      repudiation by the buyer is the difference between the market price at the time and
      place for tender and the unpaid contract price together with any incidental damages
      provided in this division (section 2710) but less expenses saved in consequence of
      the breach by the buyer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2717. Deduction of damages from price
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2717. Deduction of damages from price
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2717. Deduction of damages from price (2023)
content:
The buyer on notifying the seller of his intention to do so may deduct all or any
   part of the damages resulting from any breach of the contract from any part of the
   price still due under the same contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2720. Effect of “cancellation” or “rescission” on claims for antecedent breach
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2720. Effect of “cancellation” or “rescission” on claims for antecedent breach
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2720. Effect of “cancellation” or “rescission” on claims for antecedent breach (2023)
content:
Unless the contrary intention clearly appears, expressions of “cancellation” or “rescission”
   of the contract or the like shall not be construed as a renunciation or discharge
   of any claim in damages for an antecedent breach.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2710. Incidental damages of seller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2710. Incidental damages of seller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2710. Incidental damages of seller (2023)
content:
Incidental damages to an aggrieved seller include any commercially reasonable charges,
   expenses or commissions incurred in stopping delivery, in the transportation, care
   and custody of goods after the breach by the buyer, in connection with return or resale
   of the goods or otherwise resulting from the breach.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2715. Incidental and consequential damages of buyer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2715. Incidental and consequential damages of buyer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2715. Incidental and consequential damages of buyer (2023)
content: (a) Incidental damages.--Incidental damages resulting from the breach of the seller include:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2718. Liquidation or limitation of damages; deposits
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2718. Liquidation or limitation of damages; deposits
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2718. Liquidation or limitation of damages; deposits (2023)
content:
(a) Liquidated damages in agreement.--Damages for breach by either party may be liquidated in the agreement but only at
      an amount which is reasonable in the light of the anticipated or actual harm caused
      by the breach, the difficulties of proof of loss, and the inconvenience or nonfeasibility
      of otherwise obtaining an adequate remedy.  A term fixing unreasonably large liquidated damages is void as a penalty.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2721. Remedies for fraud
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2721. Remedies for fraud
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2721. Remedies for fraud (2023)
content:
Remedies for material misrepresentation or fraud include all remedies available under
   this division for nonfraudulent breach.  Neither rescission or a claim for rescission of the contract for sale nor rejection
   or return of the goods shall bar or be deemed inconsistent with a claim for damages
   or other remedy.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2719. Contractual modification or limitation of remedy
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2719. Contractual modification or limitation of remedy
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2719. Contractual modification or limitation of remedy (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to the provisions of subsections (b) and (c) and of section 2718 (relating
      to liquidation or limitation of damages;  deposits):

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2725. Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2725. Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2725. Statute of limitations in contracts for sale (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within four years
      after the cause of action has accrued.  By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not
      less than one year but may not extend it.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2722. Who can sue third parties for injury to goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2722. Who can sue third parties for injury to goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2722. Who can sue third parties for injury to goods (2023)
content:
Where a third party so deals with goods which have been identified to a contract for
   sale as to cause actionable injury to a party to that contract:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2724. Admissibility of market quotations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2724. Admissibility of market quotations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2724. Admissibility of market quotations (2023)
content:
Whenever the prevailing price or value of any goods regularly bought and sold in any
   established commodity market is in issue, reports in official publications or trade
   journals or newspapers or periodicals of general circulation published as the reports
   of such market shall be admissible in evidence.  The circumstances of the preparation of such a report may be shown to affect its
   weight but not its admissibility.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2. Sales›Chapter 27. Remedies›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2723. Proof of market price: time and place
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2. Sales › Chapter 27. Remedies › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2723. Proof of market price: time and place
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2723. Proof of market price: time and place (2023)
content:
(a) Determination of market price generally.--If an action based on anticipatory repudiation comes to trial before the time for
      performance with respect to some or all of the goods, any damages based on market
      price (section 2708 or 2713) shall be determined according to the price of such goods
      prevailing at the time when the aggrieved party learned of the repudiation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A101. Short title of division
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A101. Short title of division
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A101. Short title of division (2023)
content:
This division shall be known and may be cited as the Uniform Commercial Code, Article
   2A, Leases.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A105. Territorial application of division to goods covered by certificate of title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A105. Territorial application of division to goods covered by certificate of title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A105. Territorial application of division to goods covered by certificate of title (2023)
content:
Subject to the provisions of sections 2A304(c) (relating to subsequent lease of goods
   by lessor) and 2A305(c) (relating to sale or sublease of goods by lessee), with respect
   to goods covered by a certificate of title issued under a statute of this Commonwealth
   or of another jurisdiction, compliance and the effect of compliance or noncompliance
   with a certificate of title statute are governed by the law (including the conflict
   of laws rules) of the jurisdiction issuing the certificate until the earlier of:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A107. Waiver or renunciation of claim or right after default
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A107. Waiver or renunciation of claim or right after default
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A107. Waiver or renunciation of claim or right after default (2023)
content:
Any claim or right arising out of an alleged default or breach of warranty may be
   discharged in whole or in part without consideration by a waiver or renunciation in
   a signed record delivered by the aggrieved party.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A108. Unconscionability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A108. Unconscionability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A108. Unconscionability (2023)
content:
(a) Unconscionable lease.--If the court as a matter of law finds a lease contract or any clause of a lease contract
      to have been unconscionable at the time it was made, the court may refuse to enforce
      the lease contract, or it may enforce the remainder of the lease contract without
      the unconscionable clause, or it may so limit the application of any unconscionable
      clause as to avoid any unconscionable result.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A104. Leases subject to other law
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A104. Leases subject to other law
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A104. Leases subject to other law (2023)
content: (a) General rule.--A lease, although subject to this division, is also subject to any applicable:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A203. Seals inoperative
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A203. Seals inoperative
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A203. Seals inoperative (2023)
content:
The affixing of a seal to a record evidencing a lease contract or an offer to enter
   into a lease contract does not render the record a sealed instrument, and the law
   with respect to sealed instruments does not apply to the lease contract or offer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A102. Scope
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A102. Scope
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A102. Scope (2023)

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A201. Statute of frauds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A201. Statute of frauds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A201. Statute of frauds (2023)
content: (a) General rule.--A lease contract is not enforceable by way of action or defense unless:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A106. Limitation on power of parties to consumer lease to choose applicable law and judicial forum
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A106. Limitation on power of parties to consumer lease to choose applicable law and judicial forum
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A106. Limitation on power of parties to consumer lease to choose applicable law and judicial forum (2023)
content:
(a) Choice of law.--If the law chosen by the parties to a consumer lease is that of a jurisdiction other
      than a jurisdiction in which the lessee resides at the time the lease agreement becomes
      enforceable or within 30 days thereafter or in which the goods are to be used, the
      choice is not enforceable.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A205. Firm offers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A205. Firm offers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A205. Firm offers (2023)
content:
An offer by a merchant to lease goods to or from another person in a signed record
   that by its terms gives assurance it will be held open is not revocable, for lack
   of consideration, during the time stated or, if no time is stated, for a reasonable
   time, but in no event may the period of irrevocability exceed three months.  Any such term of assurance on a form supplied by the offeree must be separately
   signed by the offeror.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A103. Definitions and index of definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A103. Definitions and index of definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A103. Definitions and index of definitions (2023)
content:
(a) Definitions.--The following words and phrases when used in this division shall have, unless the
      context clearly indicates otherwise, the meanings given to them in this subsection:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A1. General Provisions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A109. Option to accelerate at will
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A1. General Provisions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A109. Option to accelerate at will
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A109. Option to accelerate at will (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A term providing that one party or his successor in interest may accelerate payment
      or performance or require collateral or additional collateral “at will” or “when he
      deems himself insecure” or in words of similar import must be construed to mean that
      he has power to do so only if he in good faith believes that the prospect of payment
      or performance is impaired.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A211. Warranties against interference and against infringement; lessee's obligation against infringement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A211. Warranties against interference and against infringement; lessee's obligation against infringement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A211. Warranties against interference and against infringement; lessee's obligation against infringement (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--There is in a lease contract a warranty that for the lease term no person holds a
      claim to or interest in the goods that arose from an act or omission of the lessor,
      other than a claim by way of infringement or the like, which will interfere with the
      lessee's enjoyment of its leasehold interest.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A210. Express warranties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A210. Express warranties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A210. Express warranties (2023)
content: (a) General rule.--Express warranties by the lessor are created as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A206. Offer and acceptance in formation of lease contract
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A206. Offer and acceptance in formation of lease contract
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A206. Offer and acceptance in formation of lease contract (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Unless otherwise unambiguously indicated by the language or circumstances, an offer
      to make a lease contract must be construed as inviting acceptance in any manner and
      by any medium reasonable in the circumstances.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A208. Modification, rescission and waiver
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A208. Modification, rescission and waiver
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A208. Modification, rescission and waiver (2023)
content: (a) Consideration unnecessary for modification.--An agreement modifying a lease contract needs no consideration to be binding.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A204. Formation in general
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A204. Formation in general
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A204. Formation in general (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A lease contract may be made in any manner sufficient to show agreement, including
      conduct by both parties which recognizes the existence of a lease contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A213. Implied warranty of fitness for particular purpose
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A213. Implied warranty of fitness for particular purpose
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A213. Implied warranty of fitness for particular purpose (2023)
content:
Except in a finance lease, if the lessor at the time the lease contract is made has
   reason to know of any particular purpose for which the goods are required and that
   the lessee is relying on the lessor's skill or judgment to select or furnish suitable
   goods, there is in the lease contract an implied warranty that the goods will be fit
   for that purpose.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A212. Implied warranty of merchantability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A212. Implied warranty of merchantability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A212. Implied warranty of merchantability (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except in a finance lease, a warranty that the goods will be merchantable is implied
      in a lease contract if the lessor is a merchant with respect to goods of that kind.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A216. Third party beneficiaries of express and implied warranties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A216. Third party beneficiaries of express and implied warranties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A216. Third party beneficiaries of express and implied warranties (2023)
content:
A warranty to or for the benefit of a lessee under this division, whether express
   or implied, extends to any natural person who is in the family or household of the
   lessee or who is a guest in the lessee's home if it is reasonable to expect that such
   person may use, consume or be affected by the goods and who is injured in person by
   breach of the warranty.  This section does not displace principles of law and equity that extend a warranty
   to or for the benefit of a lessee to other persons.  The operation of this section may not be excluded, modified or limited, but an exclusion,
   modification or limitation of the warranty, including any with respect to rights and
   remedies, effective against the lessee is also effective against any beneficiary designated
   under this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A217. Identification
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A217. Identification
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A217. Identification (2023)
content:
Identification of goods as goods to which a lease contract refers may be made at any
   time and in any manner explicitly agreed to by the parties.  In the absence of explicit agreement, identification occurs:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A209. Lessee under finance lease as beneficiary of supply contract
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A209. Lessee under finance lease as beneficiary of supply contract
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A209. Lessee under finance lease as beneficiary of supply contract (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The benefit of a supplier's promises to the lessor under the supply contract and of
      all warranties, whether express or implied, including those of any third party provided
      in connection with or as part of the supply contract extends to the lessee to the
      extent of the lessee's leasehold interest under a finance lease related to the supply
      contract, but subject to the terms of the warranty and of the supply contract and
      all defenses or claims arising therefrom.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A215. Cumulation and conflict of warranties express or implied
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A215. Cumulation and conflict of warranties express or implied
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A215. Cumulation and conflict of warranties express or implied (2023)
content:
Warranties, whether express or implied, must be construed as consistent with each
   other and as cumulative, but if that construction is unreasonable, the intention of
   the parties determines which warranty is dominant.  In ascertaining that intention, the following rules apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A202. Final expression: parol or extrinsic evidence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A202. Final expression: parol or extrinsic evidence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A202. Final expression: parol or extrinsic evidence (2023)
content:
Terms with respect to which the confirmatory memoranda of the parties agree or which
   are otherwise set forth in a record intended by the parties as a final expression
   of their agreement with respect to such terms as are included therein may not be contradicted
   by evidence of any prior agreement or of a contemporaneous oral agreement but may
   be explained or supplemented:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A214. Exclusion or modification of warranties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A214. Exclusion or modification of warranties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A214. Exclusion or modification of warranties (2023)
content:
(a) Construction of words or conduct creating or limiting warranties.--Words or conduct relevant to the creation of an express warranty and words or conduct
      tending to negate or limit a warranty must be construed wherever reasonable as consistent
      with each other;  but, subject to the provisions of section 2A202 (relating to final
      expression:  parol or extrinsic evidence), negation or limitation is inoperative to
      the extent that the construction is unreasonable.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A303. Alienability of party's interest under lease contract or of lessor's residual interest in goods; delegation of performance; transfer of rights
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A303. Alienability of party's interest under lease contract or of lessor's residual interest in goods; delegation of performance; transfer of rights
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A303. Alienability of party's interest under lease contract or of lessor's residual interest in goods; delegation of performance; transfer of rights (2023)
content:
(a) Definition.--As used in this section, the term “creation of a security interest” includes the sale of a lease contract that is subject to Division 9 (relating to
      secured transactions) by reason of section 9109(a)(3) (relating to scope).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A302. Title to and possession of goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A302. Title to and possession of goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A302. Title to and possession of goods (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in this division, each provision of this division applies
   whether the lessor or a third party has title to the goods, and whether the lessor,
   the lessee or a third party has possession of the goods, notwithstanding any statute
   or rule of law that possession or the absence of possession is fraudulent.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A221. Casualty to identified goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A221. Casualty to identified goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A221. Casualty to identified goods (2023)
content:
If a lease contract requires goods identified when the lease contract is made, and
   the goods suffer casualty without fault of the lessee, the lessor or the supplier
   before delivery, or the goods suffer casualty before risk of loss passes to the lessee
   pursuant to the lease agreement or section 2A219 (relating to risk of loss), then:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A301. Enforceability of lease contract
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A301. Enforceability of lease contract
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A301. Enforceability of lease contract (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in this division, a lease contract is effective and enforceable
   according to its terms between the parties, against purchasers of the goods and against
   creditors of the parties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A219. Risk of loss
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A219. Risk of loss
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A219. Risk of loss (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except in the case of a finance lease, risk of loss is retained by the lessor and
      does not pass to the lessee.  In the case of a finance lease, risk of loss passes to the lessee.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A304. Subsequent lease of goods by lessor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A304. Subsequent lease of goods by lessor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A304. Subsequent lease of goods by lessor (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to section 2A303 (relating to alienability of party's interest under lease
      contract or of lessor's residual interest in goods;  delegation of performance;  transfer
      of rights), a subsequent lessee from a lessor of goods under an existing lease contract
      obtains, to the extent of the leasehold interest transferred, the leasehold interest
      in the goods that the lessor had or had power to transfer, and except as provided
      in subsection (b) and section 2A527(d) (relating to lessor's rights to dispose of
      goods), takes subject to the existing lease contract.  A lessor with voidable title has power to transfer a good leasehold interest to
      a good faith subsequent lessee for value, but only to the extent set forth in the
      preceding sentence.  If goods have been delivered under a transaction of purchase, the lessor has that
      power even though:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A220. Effect of default on risk of loss
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A220. Effect of default on risk of loss
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A220. Effect of default on risk of loss (2023)
content: (a) Default by lessor.--Where risk of loss is to pass to the lessee and the time of passage is not stated:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A218. Insurance and proceeds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A2. Formation and Construction of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A218. Insurance and proceeds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A218. Insurance and proceeds (2023)
content:
(a) Insurable interest of lessee.--A lessee obtains an insurable interest when existing goods are identified to the lease
      contract even though the goods identified are nonconforming and the lessee has an
      option to reject them.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A308. Special rights of creditors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A308. Special rights of creditors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A308. Special rights of creditors (2023)
content:
(a) Creditor of lessor.--A creditor of a lessor in possession of goods subject to a lease contract may treat
      the lease contract as void if as against the creditor retention of possession by the
      lessor is fraudulent under any statute or rule of law, but retention of possession
      in good faith and current course of trade by the lessor for a commercially reasonable
      time after the lease contract becomes enforceable is not fraudulent.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A307. Priority of liens arising by attachment or levy on, security interests in, and other claims to goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A307. Priority of liens arising by attachment or levy on, security interests in, and other claims to goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A307. Priority of liens arising by attachment or levy on, security interests in, and other claims to goods (2023)
content:
(a) Creditor of lessee.--Except as otherwise provided in section 2A306 (relating to priority of certain liens
      arising by operation of law), a creditor of a lessee takes subject to the lease contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A306. Priority of certain liens arising by operation of law
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A306. Priority of certain liens arising by operation of law
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A306. Priority of certain liens arising by operation of law (2023)
content:
If a person in the ordinary course of his business furnishes services or materials
   with respect to goods subject to a lease contract, a lien upon those goods in the
   possession of that person given by statute or rule of law for those materials or services
   takes priority over any interest of the lessor or lessee under the lease contract
   or this division unless the lien is created by statute and the statute provides otherwise
   or unless the lien is created by rule of law and the rule of law provides otherwise.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A310. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become accessions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A310. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become accessions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A310. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become accessions (2023)
content: (a) Definition.--Goods are “accessions” when they are installed in or affixed to other goods.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A305. Sale or sublease of goods by lessee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A305. Sale or sublease of goods by lessee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A305. Sale or sublease of goods by lessee (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to the provisions of section 2A303 (relating to alienability of party's interest
      under lease contract or of lessor's residual interest in goods;  delegation of performance;
      transfer of rights), a buyer or sublessee from the lessee of goods under an existing
      lease contract obtains, to the extent of the interest transferred, the leasehold interest
      in the goods that the lessee had or had power to transfer, and except as provided
      in subsection (b) and section 2A511(d) (relating to merchant lessee's duties as to
      rightfully rejected goods), takes subject to the existing lease contract.  A lessee with a voidable leasehold interest has power to transfer a good leasehold
      interest to a good faith buyer for value or a good faith sublessee for value, but
      only to the extent set forth in the preceding sentence.  When goods have been delivered under a transaction of lease, the lessee has that
      power even though:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A309. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become fixtures
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A309. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become fixtures
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A309. Lessor's and lessee's rights when goods become fixtures (2023)
content:
(a) Definitions.--As used in this section, the following words and phrases shall have the meanings given
      to them in this subsection:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A402. Anticipatory repudiation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A402. Anticipatory repudiation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A402. Anticipatory repudiation (2023)
content:
If either party repudiates a lease contract with respect to a performance not yet
   due under the lease contract, the loss of which performance will substantially impair
   the value of the lease contract to the other, the aggrieved party may:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A311. Priority subject to subordination
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A3. Effect of Lease Contract › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A311. Priority subject to subordination
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A311. Priority subject to subordination (2023)
content:
Nothing in this division prevents subordination by agreement by any person entitled
   to priority.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A401. Insecurity: adequate assurance of performance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A401. Insecurity: adequate assurance of performance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A401. Insecurity: adequate assurance of performance (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A lease contract imposes an obligation on each party that the other's expectation
      of receiving due performance will not be impaired.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A501. Default: procedure
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A501. Default: procedure
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A501. Default: procedure (2023)
content:
(a) Determination of default.--Whether the lessor or the lessee is in default under a lease contract is determined
      by the lease agreement and this division.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A502. Notice after default
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A502. Notice after default
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A502. Notice after default (2023)
content:
Except as otherwise provided in this division or the lease agreement, the lessor or
   lessee in default under the lease contract is not entitled to notice of default or
   notice of enforcement from the other party to the lease agreement.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A405. Excused performance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A405. Excused performance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A405. Excused performance (2023)
content:
Subject to section 2A404 (relating to substituted performance), the following rules
   apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A406. Procedure on excused performance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A406. Procedure on excused performance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A406. Procedure on excused performance (2023)
content:
(a) Right of lessee to terminate or modify contract.--If the lessee receives notification of a material or indefinite delay or an allocation
      justified under section 2A405 (relating to excused performance), the lessee may by
      written notification to the lessor as to any goods involved, and with respect to all
      of the goods if under an installment lease contract the value of the whole lease contract
      is substantially impaired (section 2A510):

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A403. Retraction of anticipatory repudiation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A403. Retraction of anticipatory repudiation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A403. Retraction of anticipatory repudiation (2023)
content:
(a) When allowable.--Until the repudiating party's next performance is due, the repudiating party can retract
      the repudiation unless, since the repudiation, the aggrieved party has canceled the
      lease contract or materially changed the aggrieved party's position or otherwise indicated
      that the aggrieved party considers the repudiation final.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A504. Liquidation of damages
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A504. Liquidation of damages
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A504. Liquidation of damages (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Damages payable by either party for default, or any other act or omission, including
      indemnity for loss or diminution of anticipated tax benefits or loss or damage to
      lessor's residual interest, may be liquidated in the lease agreement but only at an
      amount or by a formula that is reasonable in light of the then anticipated harm caused
      by the default or other act or omission.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A505. Cancellation and termination and effect of cancellation, termination, rescission or fraud on rights and remedies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A505. Cancellation and termination and effect of cancellation, termination, rescission or fraud on rights and remedies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A505. Cancellation and termination and effect of cancellation, termination, rescission or fraud on rights and remedies (2023)
content:
(a) Cancellation of contract.--On cancellation of the lease contract, all obligations that are still executory on
      both sides are discharged, but any right based on prior default or performance survives,
      and the canceling party also retains any remedy for default of the whole lease contract
      or any unperformed balance.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A404. Substituted performance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A404. Substituted performance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A404. Substituted performance (2023)
content:
(a) Manner of delivery.--If, without fault of the lessee, the lessor and the supplier, the agreed berthing,
      loading or unloading facilities fail or the agreed type of carrier becomes unavailable
      or the agreed manner of delivery otherwise becomes commercially impracticable, but
      a commercially reasonable substitute is available, the substitute performance must
      be tendered and accepted.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A407. Irrevocable promises: finance leases
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A4. Performance of Lease Contract: Repudiated, Substituted and Excused › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A407. Irrevocable promises: finance leases
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A407. Irrevocable promises: finance leases (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--In the case of a finance lease that is not a consumer lease, the lessee's promises
      under the lease contract become irrevocable and independent upon the lessee's acceptance
      of the goods.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A506. Statute of limitations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A506. Statute of limitations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A506. Statute of limitations (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--An action for default under a lease contract, including breach of warranty or indemnity,
      must be commenced within four years after the cause of action accrued.  By the original lease contract the parties may reduce the period of limitation to
      not less than one year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A503. Modification or impairment of rights and remedies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A503. Modification or impairment of rights and remedies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A503. Modification or impairment of rights and remedies (2023)
content:
(a) Provisions in lease agreements.--Except as otherwise provided in this division, the lease agreement may include rights
      and remedies for default in addition to or in substitution for those provided in this
      division and may limit or alter the measure of damages recoverable under this division.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A508. Lessee's remedies

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A508. Lessee's remedies (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If a lessor fails to deliver the goods in conformity to the lease contract (section
      2A509) or repudiates the lease contract (section 2A402), or a lessee rightfully rejects
      the goods (section 2A509) or justifiably revokes acceptance of the goods (section
      2A517), then with respect to any goods involved, and with respect to all of the goods
      if under an installment lease contract the value of the whole lease contract is substantially
      impaired (section 2A510), the lessor is in default under the lease contract and the
      lessee may:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A518. Cover; substitute goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A518. Cover; substitute goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A518. Cover; substitute goods (2023)
content:
(a) Right and manner of cover.--After default by a lessor under the lease contract of the type described in section
      2A508(a) (relating to lessee's remedies) or, if agreed, after other default by the
      lessor, the lessee may cover by making any purchase or lease of or contract to purchase
      or lease goods in substitution for those due from the lessor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A515. Acceptance of goods

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A515. Acceptance of goods (2023)
content:

      the goods and:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A517. Revocation of acceptance of goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A517. Revocation of acceptance of goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A517. Revocation of acceptance of goods (2023)
content:

      impairs its value to the lessee if the lessee has accepted it:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter A. In General›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A507. Proof of market rent: time and place
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter A. In General › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A507. Proof of market rent: time and place
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A507. Proof of market rent: time and place (2023)
content:
(a) Rent prevailing;  general rule.--Damages based on market rent (section 2A519 or 2A528) are determined according to
      the rent for the use of the goods concerned for a lease term identical to the remaining
      lease term of the original lease agreement and prevailing at the times specified in
      sections 2A519 (relating to lessee's damages for nondelivery, repudiation, default
      and breach of warranty in regard to accepted goods) and 2A528 (relating to lessor's
      damages for nonacceptance, failure to pay, repudiation or other default).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A512. Lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A512. Lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A512. Lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided with respect to goods that threaten to decline in value
      speedily (section 2A511) and subject to any security interest of a lessee (section
      2A508(e)):

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A510. Installment lease contracts: rejection and default
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A510. Installment lease contracts: rejection and default
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A510. Installment lease contracts: rejection and default (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Under an installment lease contract, a lessee may reject any delivery that is nonconforming
      if the nonconformity substantially impairs the value of that delivery and cannot be
      cured or the nonconformity is a defect in the required documents;  but if the nonconformity
      does not fall within subsection (b) and the lessor or the supplier gives adequate
      assurance of its cure, the lessee must accept that delivery.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A509. Lessee's rights on improper delivery; rightful rejection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A509. Lessee's rights on improper delivery; rightful rejection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A509. Lessee's rights on improper delivery; rightful rejection (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to the provisions of section 2A510 (relating to installment lease contracts:
      rejection and default) on default in installment lease contracts, if the goods or
      the tender or delivery fail in any respect to conform to the lease contract, the lessee
      may reject or accept the goods or accept any commercial unit or units and reject the
      rest of the goods.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A516. title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A516. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A516. Effect of acceptance of goods; notice of default; burden of establishing default after acceptance; notice of claim or litigation to person answerable over (2023)
content:
(a) Payment for accepted goods.--A lessee must pay rent for any goods accepted in accordance with the lease contract,
      with due allowance for goods rightfully rejected or not delivered.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A514. Waiver of lessee's objections
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A514. Waiver of lessee's objections
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A514. Waiver of lessee's objections (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--In rejecting goods, a lessee's failure to state a particular defect that is ascertainable
      by reasonable inspection precludes the lessee from relying on the defect to justify
      rejection or to establish default:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A511. Merchant lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A511. Merchant lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A511. Merchant lessee's duties as to rightfully rejected goods (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to any security interest of a lessee (section 2A508(e)), if a lessor or a
      supplier has no agent or place of business at the market of rejection, a merchant
      lessee, after rejection of goods in his possession or control, shall follow any reasonable
      instructions received from the lessor or the supplier with respect to the goods.  In the absence of those instructions, a merchant lessee shall make reasonable efforts
      to sell, lease or otherwise dispose of the goods for the lessor's account if they
      threaten to decline in value speedily.  Instructions are not reasonable if on demand indemnity for expenses is not forthcoming.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A521. Lessee's right to specific performance or replevin
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A521. Lessee's right to specific performance or replevin
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A521. Lessee's right to specific performance or replevin (2023)
content: (a) Specific performance.--Specific performance may be decreed if the goods are unique or in other proper circumstances.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A522. Lessee's right to goods on lessor's insolvency
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A522. Lessee's right to goods on lessor's insolvency
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A522. Lessee's right to goods on lessor's insolvency (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Subject to subsection (b) and even though the goods have not been shipped, a lessee
      who has paid a part or all of the rent and security for goods identified to a lease
      contract (section 2A217) on making and keeping good a tender of any unpaid portion
      of the rent and security due under the lease contract may recover the goods identified
      from the lessor if the lessor becomes insolvent within ten days after receipt of the
      first installment of rent and security.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A520. Lessee's incidental and consequential damages
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A520. Lessee's incidental and consequential damages
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A520. Lessee's incidental and consequential damages (2023)
content:
(a) Incidental damages.--Incidental damages resulting from a lessor's default include expenses reasonably incurred
      in inspection, receipt, transportation, and care and custody of goods rightfully rejected
      or goods the acceptance of which is justifiably revoked, any commercially reasonable
      charges, expenses or commissions in connection with effecting cover, and any other
      reasonable expense incident to the default.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A519. Lessee's damages for nondelivery, repudiation, default and breach of warranty in regard to accepted goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A519. Lessee's damages for nondelivery, repudiation, default and breach of warranty in regard to accepted goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A519. Lessee's damages for nondelivery, repudiation, default and breach of warranty in regard to accepted goods (2023)
content:
(a) Measure of damages for nondelivery or rejection.--Except as otherwise provided with respect to damages liquidated in the lease agreement
      (section 2A504) or otherwise determined pursuant to agreement of the parties (sections
      1302 and 2A503), if a lessee elects not to cover or a lessee elects to cover and the
      cover is by lease agreement that for any reason does not qualify for treatment under
      section 2A518(b) (relating to cover;  substitute goods), or is by purchase or otherwise,
      the measure of damages for nondelivery or repudiation by the lessor or for rejection
      or revocation of acceptance by the lessee is the present value, as of the date of
      the default, of the then market rent minus the present value as of the same date of
      the original rent, computed for the remaining lease term of the original lease agreement,
      together with incidental and consequential damages, less expenses saved in consequence
      of the lessor's default.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter B. Default by Lessor›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A513. Cure by lessor of improper tender or delivery; replacement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter B. Default by Lessor › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A513. Cure by lessor of improper tender or delivery; replacement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A513. Cure by lessor of improper tender or delivery; replacement (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If any tender or delivery by the lessor or the supplier is rejected because nonconforming
      and the time for performance has not yet expired, the lessor or the supplier may seasonably
      notify the lessee of the lessor's or the supplier's intention to cure and may then
      make a conforming delivery within the time provided in the lease contract.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A527. Lessor's rights to dispose of goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter C. Default by Lessee › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A527. Lessor's rights to dispose of goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A527. Lessor's rights to dispose of goods (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--After a default by a lessee under the lease contract of the type described in section
      2A523(a) or (c)(1) (relating to lessor's remedies) or after the lessor refuses to
      deliver or takes possession of goods (section 2A525 or 2A526) or, if agreed, after
      other default by a lessee, the lessor may dispose of the goods concerned or the undelivered
      balance thereof by lease, sale or otherwise.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A531. Standing to sue third parties for injury to goods

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A525. Lessor's right to possession of goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter C. Default by Lessee › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A525. Lessor's right to possession of goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A525. Lessor's right to possession of goods (2023)
content:
(a) Insolvency of lessee.--If a lessor discovers the lessee to be insolvent, the lessor may refuse to deliver
      the goods.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A530. Lessor's incidental damages
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter C. Default by Lessee › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A530. Lessor's incidental damages
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A530. Lessor's incidental damages (2023)
content:
Incidental damages to an aggrieved lessor include any commercially reasonable charges,
   expenses or commissions incurred in stopping delivery, in the transportation, care
   and custody of goods after the lessee's default, in connection with return or disposition
   of the goods, or otherwise resulting from the default.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 3. Negotiable Instruments›Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3102. Subject matter
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 3. Negotiable Instruments › Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3102. Subject matter
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3102. Subject matter (2023)
content:
(a) Applicability.--This division applies to negotiable instruments.  It does not apply to money, to payment orders governed by Division 4A (relating
      to funds transfers) or to securities governed by Division 8 (relating to investment
      securities).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A529. Lessor's action for the rent

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A529. Lessor's action for the rent (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--After default by the lessee under the lease contract of the type described in section
      2A523(a) or (c)(1) (relating to lessor's remedies) or, if agreed, after other default
      by the lessee, if the lessor complies with subsection (b), the lessor may recover

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A526. Lessor's stoppage of delivery in transit or otherwise
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter C. Default by Lessee › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A526. Lessor's stoppage of delivery in transit or otherwise
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A526. Lessor's stoppage of delivery in transit or otherwise (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A lessor may stop delivery of goods in the possession of a carrier or other bailee
      if the lessor discovers the lessee to be insolvent and may stop delivery of carload,
      truckload, planeload or larger shipments of express or freight if the lessee repudiates
      or fails to make a payment due before delivery, whether for rent, security or otherwise
      under the lease contract, or for any other reason the lessor has a right to withhold
      or take possession of the goods.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 2A. Leases›Chapter 2A5. Default›Subchapter C. Default by Lessee›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A528. Lessor's damages for nonacceptance, failure to pay, repudiation or other default
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 2A. Leases › Chapter 2A5. Default › Subchapter C. Default by Lessee › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A528. Lessor's damages for nonacceptance, failure to pay, repudiation or other default
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 2A528. Lessor's damages for nonacceptance, failure to pay, repudiation or other default (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided with respect to damages liquidated in the lease agreement
      (section 2A504) or otherwise determined pursuant to agreement of the parties (sections
      1302 and 2A523), if a lessor elects to retain the goods or a lessor elects to dispose
      of the goods and the disposition is by lease agreement that for any reason does not
      qualify for treatment under section 2A527(b) (relating to lessor's rights to dispose
      of goods), or is by sale or otherwise, the lessor may recover from the lessee as damages
      for a default of the type described in section 2A523(a) or (c)(1) (relating to lessor's

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 3. Negotiable Instruments›Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3107. Instrument payable in foreign money
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 3. Negotiable Instruments › Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3107. Instrument payable in foreign money
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3107. Instrument payable in foreign money (2023)
content:
Unless the instrument otherwise provides, an instrument that states the amount payable
   in foreign money may be paid in the foreign money or in an equivalent amount in dollars
   calculated by using the current bank-offered spot rate at the place of payment for
   the purchase of dollars on the day on which the instrument is paid.

content:
(a) Definition of “negotiable instrument”.--Except as provided in subsections (c) and (d), “negotiable instrument” means an unconditional
      promise or order to pay a fixed amount of money, with or without interest or other

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code›Division 3. Negotiable Instruments›Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions›PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3101. Short title of division
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 13 Pa.C.S.A. Commercial Code › Division 3. Negotiable Instruments › Chapter 31. General Provisions and Definitions › PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3101. Short title of division
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 13 Pa.C.S.A. § 3101. Short title of division (2023)
content: This division shall be known and may be cited as theUniform Commercial Code, Article 3, Negotiable Instruments.
